name: attribute pattern: EAV rows attached to customer documents (count per customer)
source_sql: SELECT e.entity_id AS cust_id, COUNT(*) AS n_attrs FROM entity_attr_value e WHERE e.entity_type = 'CUSTOMER' GROUP BY e.entity_id ORDER BY e.entity_id

name: TAX_REGION_OVERRIDE spellings survive as strings (distinct value, count)
source_sql: SELECT attr_value AS val, COUNT(*) AS n FROM entity_attr_value WHERE entity_type = 'CUSTOMER' AND attr_name = 'TAX_REGION_OVERRIDE' GROUP BY attr_value ORDER BY attr_value

name: customers per tenant and status code (the 155-column table, grouped)
source_sql: SELECT tenant_id AS tenant_id, status_cd AS status_cd, COUNT(*) AS n FROM customer_master GROUP BY tenant_id, status_cd

name: history archive: hist rows per operation (trigger output, loaded once)
source_sql: SELECT hist_op AS hist_op, COUNT(*) AS n FROM customer_master_hist GROUP BY hist_op
